unavailable.noContext: Open the task to review its current state.
unavailable.notActive: This recovery notice is no longer active.
unavailable.stateChanged: The task’s state has changed. Review its current state before retrying.
unavailable.recoveryChanged: The task’s recovery state has changed. Refresh to see the current action.
unavailable.agentChanged: The assigned agent has changed. Review the task before retrying.
unavailable.pendingInteraction: Respond to the pending question or confirmation before retrying.
unavailable.activeRun: The task already has an active run. Wait for it to finish.
unavailable.waitingReview: The task is waiting for a review or approval.
unavailable.blockers: Resolve the task’s blockers before retrying.
unavailable.agentPaused: The assigned agent is paused. Resume the agent before retrying.
unavailable.agentTerminated: The assigned agent is no longer available.

description.start: The agent stopped without recording an outcome or a next step.
description.budgetBlocked: {{start}} Automatic recovery stopped because a spending or pause limit prevents the agent from running.
description.notInvokable: {{start}} Automatic recovery stopped because the assigned agent is unavailable.
description.exhausted_one: {{start}} {{attempts}} automatic attempt to resolve this failed.
description.exhausted_other: {{start}} {{attempts}} automatic attempts to resolve this failed.
description.stopped: {{start}} Automatic recovery stopped. Review the details before trying again.

refreshAndRetry: Refresh the task to check its current state, then try again.
returnedToTodo: The task was returned to To do for {{agentName}}.

details.explanation: Recovery asked the assigned agent to record an outcome or a next step. Retrying keeps the same task and agent, and checks the task’s current controls before continuing.
